title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Repayment Plan Rule
content:
**Scope.** This rule governs monthly repayment plans on Benefit Overpayment Accounts.

**1. Agreement.** A claimant may agree a monthly repayment plan instead of paying the balance at once.

**2. Status condition.** A repayment plan is set only while the overpayment status is established or in recovery. The status is read from the Department's overpayment record of the overpayment the plan is for.

**3. Installment amount — no longer in force.** The clause "The monthly installment is at least the classification's minimum monthly payment and at least the balance divided by the classification's maximum plan months, rounded up to the cent; the claimant may choose a larger installment." is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the Department's current basis for working out plan installments.

**4. Due dates.** The first installment is due the first-payment days after the plan is set and later installments on the due day of each month.

**5. Missed installments and default.** An installment not received by the end of the grace days after its due date is missed. The plan is defaulted when the count of missed plan payments reaches the classification's default count. That count is the number of consecutive most recent due dates whose grace period ended with no repayment of at least the monthly installment received from the due date through the end of the grace period. A defaulted plan allows referral for tax refund offset and ends any interest suspension.

**6. Effect of a current plan.** A current plan blocks referral for tax refund offset but does not stop benefit offsets.

**7. Several overpayments.** When several overpayments are open, one plan may cover them all, and installments are applied under the Department's recovery order for open overpayments.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A plan's installment of USD 80.00 falls due on 15 March, and the grace period is 10 calendar days, ending on 25 March.

| Repayments received from 15 March through 25 March | 15 March installment |
|---|---|
| USD 80.00 on 24 March | Not missed |
| USD 50.00 on 20 March, nothing else | Missed (less than the installment) |
| USD 80.00 on 27 March, nothing earlier | Missed (received after the grace period) |

If the 15 February installment had also been missed, the two most recent due dates are both missed: a plan whose classification defaults at two consecutive missed installments is then defaulted, and so is a plan whose classification defaults at one.

superseded_clauses: The monthly installment is at least the classification's minimum monthly payment and at least the balance divided by the classification's maximum plan months, rounded up to the cent; the claimant may choose a larger installment.
